body:
Trust Hub compliance cleared, provisioned the full real trunk via API: trunk carepyre.pstn.twilio.com, IP ACL for this box own static IP, Origination URI, and a real phone number (+17855315546, dollar1.15/mo) assigned to the trunk. Real domain baked directly into ops/asterisk/pjsip_twilio_trunk.conf (no more placeholder). sudo-queue/52-carepyre-asterisk-plumbing-deploy.sh updated to reflect this and is a complete one-shot deploy now. Not yet run against the live Asterisk instance -- needs real root. PARENA commit 4132bf9, MONOREPO commit 4891c2e.

⚓ ☃
title: TWILLIO-OPS-12433: real Twilio trunk provisioned via API end to end
